title: Design: A/R Collection loading, empty and error states look as described
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has open invoices only at {Location-B}.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST D-21 States.
  • You can switch this computer's network connection off and on (for example Wi-Fi).
  • Starting screen: A/R Collection (Reports, then "A/R Aging Collection" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • Sales By Customer (Reports, then "Sales By Customer" under PERFORMANCE in the left menu) is open in a second tab of the same window, for comparison.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Change the as-of date to yesterday and watch the table straight away.
  2. Change the as-of date back to today.
  3. In the Location menu, untick {Location-B}.
  4. In the Customer filter, tick {Customer-A}.
  5. Read the empty state, letter for letter, and compare it with Sales By Customer's empty state.
  6. Click "Clear all filters".
  7. Switch the network connection off.
  8. Change the as-of date to yesterday.
  9. Read the table area and the message.
  10. Switch the network back on.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the native table progress bar shows while the report loads.
  • Step 2: the report shows today again.
  • Step 3: the report narrows to {Location-A}.
  • Step 4: the report has no rows: {Customer-A} has nothing open at {Location-A}.
  • Step 5: "No record matches these filters" and "Try changing filters to widen your results.", with a "Clear all filters" button, in the native empty-state look of Sales By Customer; no Totals row.
  • Step 6: the filters return to their defaults and rows show.
  • Step 7: the computer is offline.
  • Step 8: the report fails to load.
  • Step 9: "Something went wrong loading this report. Please try again." in place of the rows, and the standard error message as well.
  • Step 10: the connection is back.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11538 (Story 8, Report descriptions and layout)

  • S8-R5: “While a report loads it shows the native table progress bar. When the filters leave no rows, it shows the native empty state: "No record matches these filters" and "Try changing filters to widen your results.", with a "Clear all filters" button when a customer or vendor, Past due or Location is chosen; that button keeps the as-of date and returns the customer or vendor, Past due and Location to their defaults (every location ticked).”
  • S8-R6: “If a report fails to load, it shows "Something went wrong loading this report. Please try again." in place of the rows, with the standard error message.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Filters leave no rows | "No record matches these filters", "Try changing filters to widen your results." | Native empty state with "Clear all filters"”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Report fails to load | "Something went wrong loading this report. Please try again." | In place of the rows, plus the standard error toast”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html). The design pictures one empty state (No locations on A/R Detail); the loading bar and the load error are not drawn.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p4-cleared-no-locations.png: figure "Cleared: No locations" (This build (after)), board "4. Location filter and Location column"

The design's own words:

  • ""Clear selection" leaves no location chosen: the chip reads "Location: No locations" and stays visible, and the table shows the native empty state "No record matches these filters" with "Clear all filters". S5-R6a, S5-R9." (caption of "Cleared: No locations")

Difference from the PRD (DD-03): the PRD says with no location ticked, "the native empty state (S8-R5) with "Clear all filters", no totals and no Location column" (S5-R6a); the design shows "Location: No locations" with a Totals row reading $0.00 and $0.00 under the headings, above the empty state. This case follows the PRD; the difference is question 13 on Chris Ward's question sheet (added 22 Oct 2026); the design version is held in D-78.
